status: Quenderin extension; source foundation only, not installed or advertised by the current Host companion

success.readOnly: Strict Boolean describing Host writer state; both true and false are valid. This operation is always read-only.
success.nonSuccess: Reject as a bounded read failure; do not display raw Host error payloads or change session state.

identity.strings: Nonempty, NUL-free, valid Unicode scalar values; compare exact UTF-8, never normalize.
identity.workspace: Request and response must exactly match the authenticated coordinator workspace; null discovery scope cannot issue this read.
identity.duplicates: Reject duplicate bot IDs or duplicate current session IDs within a snapshot.
identity.binding: Host, connection generation and origin remain authenticated local context, never accepted from this response.

projection.input: Explicit already-materialized object: ready, workspaceId, revision, readOnly, bots. Bot entries supply current authoritative sessionId plus display metadata. Extra source fields are ignored, never forwarded.
projection.notReady: ready must be true; never load, refresh, bootstrap, migrate, resolve agents, read a secret, call a provider or discover a runtime to make it ready.
projection.purity: No I/O, callbacks, mutation or effects. Reject malformed source and accessor properties in required input fields rather than executing accessors.
projection.authority: The future installed adapter must derive current bot/session ownership from authoritative Host state; this pure projector does not establish that provenance.

lifecycle: Negotiate both capabilities on each authenticated connection; clear on reconnect/disconnect and before renegotiation.
Use existing RPC correlation, deadlines, capacity and stale-generation rejection.
Route results are not Harness Gateway envelopes; preserve the existing session-call parser unchanged.
Read operations never write the mutation journal and never authorize a tool/card action.
No UI, persistence migration, generic plugin proxy, route activation, capability advertisement or DS Bot installation in this increment.
